AnaBioticGrenadeContactHealing.name: Contact Healing
AnaBioticGrenadeContactHealing.description: Hitting Heroes with Biotic Grenade increases its damage and healing by 30% per Hero hit.

AnaSleepingDartSlumberShells.name: Slumber Shells
AnaSleepingDartSlumberShells.description: Reduce the cooldown of Sleep Dart by 2 seconds. Upon waking, enemy Heroes are Slowed by 25% for 3 seconds.

AnaShrikeVampiricRounds.name: Vampiric Rounds
AnaShrikeVampiricRounds.description: Increase Shrike's healing by 15%. Repeatable Quest: Stack 5 Doses to increase Shrike's healing by 1%. Repeatable Quest: Basic Attack a Hero with 5 Doses to increase Shrike's healing by 0.25%.

AnaBioticGrenadeBioticEnhancements.name: Biotic Enhancements
AnaBioticGrenadeBioticEnhancements.description: Increase the bonus healing duration of Biotic Grenade by 50% and reduce its cooldown by 3 seconds.

AnaOverdose.name: Overdose
AnaOverdose.description: Sleep Dart applies 4 Doses. While Aim Down Sights is active, Sleep Dart pierces all enemy Heroes.

AnaDebilitatingDart.name: Debilitating Dart
AnaDebilitatingDart.description: Fire a dart which Slows the Movement Speed and reduces the damage dealt by the first enemy Hero it hits by 50% for 4 seconds. If no Heroes are hit, reduce this cooldown by 8 seconds.

AnaBioticGrenadeAntiHealer.name: Anti-Healer
AnaBioticGrenadeAntiHealer.description: Increase the area of Biotic Grenade by 25% and the duration of the healing reduction by 0.75 seconds.

AnaSleepDartNightTerrors.name: Night Terrors
AnaSleepDartNightTerrors.description: Gain 25% Movement Speed for 2 seconds for every Hero hit by Sleep Dart. Upon waking, enemy Heroes take 8% of their Maximum Health in damage.

AnaMindNumbingAgent.name: Mind-Numbing Agent
AnaMindNumbingAgent.description: Every Dose a Hero has reduces their Spell Power by 10%.

AnaHeroicAbilityNanaBoost.name: Nano Boost
AnaHeroicAbilityNanaBoost.description: Instantly boost an allied Hero, restoring 200 Mana. For the next 8 seconds, they gain 30% Spell Power and their Basic Ability cooldowns recharge 150% faster. Cannot be used on Ana.

AnaHeroicAbilityEyeOfHorus.name: Eye of Horus
AnaHeroicAbilityEyeOfHorus.description: Assume a sniping position, gaining the ability to fire up to 6 specialized rounds with unlimited range. Rounds pierce allied and enemy Heroes but collide with enemy Structures in their path. Allies are healed for 225 and enemies are damaged for 135. Deals 50% less damage to Struc

AnaHealingDartSpeedSerum.name: Speed Serum
AnaHealingDartSpeedSerum.description: Healing Dart grants 25% Movement Speed to affected Heroes for 2 seconds.

AnaHealingDartPurifyingDarts.name: Purifying Darts
AnaHealingDartPurifyingDarts.description: Healing Dart removes Roots and Slows from the target, and heals for 20% more when doing so.

AnaHealingDartSmellingSalts.name: Smelling Salts
AnaHealingDartSmellingSalts.description: Healing Dart removes Stuns from the target, and grants them 50 Armor for 2 seconds when doing so.

AnaHealingDartSharpshooter.name: Sharpshooter
AnaHealingDartSharpshooter.description: Healing Dart's healing is increased by 5% if it heals a Hero, up to 50%. At maximum bonus, further increase its healing by 35%. This bonus is reset if Healing Dart fails to hit a Hero.

AnaHealingDartConcentratedDoses.name: Concentrated Doses
AnaHealingDartConcentratedDoses.description: Increase Healing Dart's healing by 12% for each Dose active on enemy Heroes.

AnaDetachableBoxMagazine.name: Active Reload
AnaDetachableBoxMagazine.description: Activate to instantly gain 3 charges of Healing Dart.

AnaNanoInfusion.name: Nano Infusion
AnaNanoInfusion.description: Allies affected by Nano Boost heal for 50% of Spell Damage dealt.

AnaEyeOfHorusDeadeye.name: Deadeye
AnaEyeOfHorusDeadeye.description: Eye of Horus cooldown reduced to 6 seconds, but it only regains new rounds every 10 seconds. Remaining cooldown is converted to rounds. For every Hero Eye of Horus hits, increases its damage and healing by 5%. This bonus resets after leaving Eye of Horus or after 4 seconds.

AnaShrikeArmoredStance.name: Armored Stance
AnaShrikeArmoredStance.description: Increase Shrike's damage by 50%. While Aim Down Sights is active, gain 25 Armor.

AnaDynamicOptics.name: Dynamic Optics
AnaDynamicOptics.description: Basic Attacks increase Attack Speed by 10% for 3 seconds, up to 100%. While Aim Down Sights is active, increase your Basic Attack Range by 4.
